clips.title: The story
paras: Agathelos the Raging is a colossal armored boar penned within the thorned tunnels of Razorfen Kraul. Reared by the Death's Head quilboar as a living siege engine and avatar of their ancient god, he has been driven into a violent, unnatural frenzy. His sheer mass and strength make him one of the most dangerous beasts lurking under the southern Barrens.

Quilboar venerate all swine as descendants of their patron deity and progenitor, the god Agamaggan. To them, boars of exceptional size and tenacity are considered direct blessings from their fallen god. A beast the size of Agathelos—standing roughly twice as tall as a Barrens thunder lizard—carries massive spiritual and ceremonial significance among the Razorfen tribes.
